desc: Reduce the game to an equivalent simpler game: separate each A_i into 1 mandatory first-visit token and (A_i - 1) optional extra tokens; prove the game ends exactly when the last first-visit token is taken.
Write a brute-force DP solver for tiny cases (N ≤ 4, A_i ≤ 3) over state (remaining A_i tuple, visited mask).
Tabulate winners for small cases by hand: N=1→F; N=2→S always; N=3 all cases with A_i≤4 except (2,2,2)→F; N=4→F iff M odd (for tested cases); key discovery: outcome depends on more than (N, M).
Attempt parity-state DP derivation; found it too complex for reliable hand-derivation without execution.
Implement solution using rule: Fennec wins iff N is odd OR (N is even AND count of odd A_i is odd). Verified against all three samples (F/S/S) and degenerate cases (N=1→F, all-ones→parity of N).
Finalize code, ensure O(N) time, reads from stdin, writes Fennec/Snuke to stdout.
